findings.base_color_default_warning: V4 contains linked Base Color sockets whose unused socket defaults remain [0.8,0.8,0.8,1], for example plaster and paving. Their material.diffuse_color values are explicitly colored, not default white. Reading the unused socket default would be wrong; the existing exporter instead uses diffuse_color and loses spatial variation.

structural_export_losses: scripts/export_viewer.py reconstructs simplified Principled materials. Linked Base Color uses material.diffuse_color, not shader evaluation or texture baking.
Linked scalar Map Range inputs are reduced to the average of To Min and To Max. This loses spatial roughness variation and ignores the distribution of the driving mask.
Procedural Normal, Coat Normal, Coat Weight and Coat Roughness are not transferred. Texture coordinates and tangents are disabled for the structural GLB.
Source transmission is recorded only in metadata, not assigned to the export shader. Glass is approximated with alpha 0.18; canal water loses its source transmission 0.32.
All 20 source lights are excluded. The procedural world, Cycles indirect light, source color-management configuration and depth-haze compositor are not embedded in the structural GLB.
The actual rippled water geometry is retained, but source scene reflections and refraction are not captured by the structural export.
BEVEL, SUBSURF and WEIGHTED_NORMAL modifiers are disabled during structural export; this also changes edge highlights and shading without changing source geometry.

viewer_recommendations.scope: Implementation suggestions, not a claim of identical Cycles output or measured visual fidelity.
viewer_recommendations.color_management: Use the audited linear RGB values. Exposure 1.0 in Blender is one stop; do not assume a viewer exposure parameter has the same numeric convention. AgX plus the Blender Medium High Contrast look is not reproduced merely by copying the exposure number.
viewer_recommendations.light_units: Energy is the source Blender light power with normalize=true. Do not copy W values directly to an API using luminous intensity without a deliberate conversion or visual calibration. Area disk emitters also cannot be replaced exactly by point lights.
shadow_priority: Use already baked static illumination for baked unlit material groups; do not add the same diffuse lighting again.
For non-baked surfaces, start with localized shadows from Lamp 1 warm light and Lamp 2 warm light, then assess whether the bridge-side Lamp 3 warm light is necessary.
The broad Soft cool dusk fill is a 15-unit disk, so any single shadow-casting directional or point-light proxy is an approximation, not the source emitter.
Avoid enabling shadow maps for all 15 point lights initially. Bound shadow coverage around the visible shops and bridge rather than the 799.6-unit extended canal.
viewer_recommendations.water: The water already has 19656 vertices and 19250 faces. Improve its normals, roughness and reflection sampling without adding a second water mesh. Use the glTF Y-up surface near y=0; world-only HDR provides sky reflections but cannot itself contain reflections of the shops and bridge.
viewer_recommendations.environment: A world-only linear HDR can preserve the source sky lighting and color distribution. It does not contain the source area lights, local emitters, geometry occlusion or compositor depth haze.

notes: Read-only background Blender inspection; no render and no source save. Source SHA256 was checked unchanged.
Only relative project source names are published. No absolute local paths are included.
World and compositor inputs are indexed because multiple sockets can share a name; linked sockets report their actual source rather than unused defaults.
material_examples includes selected relevant nodes, not a complete serialized shader network. material_summary covers every source Principled material.
